title: Elon Musk blames Indian 'oligarchs' for stalling Starlink launch
summary: Elon Musk accused Indian oligarchs of deliberately blocking Starlink's entry to protect their telecommunications monopoly. The claim highlights regulatory barriers for the satellite internet provider in one of the world's largest markets. The allegation underscores tensions between foreign tech companies and domestic business interests in India.
content: Space X founder Elon Musk accused oligarchs in India of keeping Starlink out of the country to protect their monopoly over consumers.

zh.title: 埃隆·马斯克指责印度"寡头"阻挠星链发射
zh.summary: 埃隆·马斯克指责印度寡头故意阻止星链进入以保护其电信垄断地位。这一指控突显了卫星互联网提供商在全球最大市场之一面临的监管壁垒。该指控强调了外国科技公司与印度国内商业利益之间的紧张关系。

title: Oil gains as Middle East hostilities, potential escalation stoke supply worries
summary: Oil prices rose amid escalating Middle East tensions, with reports indicating the Trump administration is considering large-scale military operations in Iran in coming weeks. The potential military action has heightened concerns about disruption to global oil supplies and commodity prices.
content: President Donald Trump and his national security team have talked about possibly restarting large-scale U.S. military operations in Iran in the coming weeks, NBC News reported.

zh.title: 中东局势升级担忧推高油价
zh.summary: 在中东局势升级之际油价上涨，报道显示特朗普政府正在考虑在未来几周对伊朗进行大规模军事行动。潜在的军事行动加剧了对全球石油供应和商品价格中断的担忧。

title: Stock futures are little changed after S&P 500 retreats from record: Live updates
summary: The S&P 500 pulled back from record highs as elevated bond yields pressured stock valuations. Despite the retreat, markets have remained relatively resilient, with investor confidence weathering higher rates.
content: The stock market continues to remain resilient even as higher yields dent investor appetite.

zh.title: 标普500指数回调后股指期货基本持平
zh.summary: 由于债券收益率上升对股票估值造成压力，标普500指数从创纪录高位回调。尽管出现回调，市场仍保持相对韧性，投资者信心抵御了利率上升的影响。

title: 'Come all the way' back to EU, French finance minister tells UK
summary: French Finance Minister Roland Lescure urged the UK to rejoin the European Union, emphasizing that EU membership enables countries to better address global challenges. The remarks signal France's continued interest in UK re-engagement with the bloc.
content: Roland Lescure tells the BBC that being in the bloc enables members to better address the challenges facing the world.

zh.title: 法国财政部长敦促英国"完全回归"欧盟
zh.summary: 法国财政部长罗兰·莱斯库尔敦促英国重新加入欧盟，强调欧盟成员身份使各国能够更好地应对全球挑战。这些言论表明法国继续对英国与欧盟重新接触感兴趣。

title: Trump says he is not keen on a deal with Iran as U.S. reportedly prepares for 'massive bombing'
summary: President Trump stated his opposition to negotiating with Iran while his national security team reportedly discusses potential large-scale military operations in coming weeks. The conflicting signals suggest internal debate over the administration's Iran strategy.
content: The U.S. president and his national security team have discussed possibly resuming large-scale U.S. military operations in the coming weeks, NBC News reported.

zh.title: 特朗普表示无意与伊朗达成交易，美国据称准备进行"大规模轰炸"
zh.summary: 特朗普总统声称反对与伊朗谈判，同时他的国家安全团队据报正在讨论未来数周可能进行的大规模军事行动。这些相互矛盾的信号表明政府内部对伊朗战略存在分歧。

title: AI chip boom pushes Samsung profits to record $80bn
summary: Samsung's profits reached record levels driven by surging demand for AI chips in the global market. The company expects additional growth from newly launched folding devices, reflecting the semiconductor industry's strategic importance in the AI era.
content: The tech giant is also expected to get a boost from its latest folding devices that were launched in August.

zh.title: AI芯片热潮推动三星利润创纪录的800亿美元
zh.summary: 三星的利润受全球人工智能芯片需求激增的驱动而创下历史新高。该公司预计将从新推出的折叠设备中获得额外增长，这反映了半导体行业在人工智能时代的战略重要性。

title: ‘He grew up wealthy’: My husband inherited $3 million. He wants a vacation home. I want to save for retirement. Who’s right?
summary: A couple faces conflicting financial priorities as the husband seeks to purchase a vacation home after inheriting $3 million, while his wife prioritizes retirement savings. The dilemma highlights common tensions in wealth management and lifestyle spending decisions within marriages.
content: “I keep thinking about giving each child $750,000 toward a house.”

zh.title: "他从小就很富有":我丈夫继承了300万美元。他想要一个度假屋。我想为退休储蓄。谁是对的?
zh.summary: 一对夫妇面临相互矛盾的财务优先事项,丈夫在继承300万美元后寻求购买度假屋,而妻子优先考虑退休储蓄。这一困境突出了财富管理和生活方式支出决策中常见的婚姻紧张关系。

title: Samsung forecasts record third-quarter profit of $80 billion as AI boom fuels chip demand
summary: Samsung Electronics reported preliminary third-quarter results with record operating profit exceeding 100 trillion won, driven by unprecedented demand for AI chips. The company's strong performance reflects the semiconductor industry's critical role in powering AI infrastructure.
content: Samsung Electronics reported preliminary third-quarter earnings on Thursday, with operating profit forecast to top 100 trillion won for the first time.

zh.title: 三星预测第三季度创纪录利润达800亿美元,AI热潮推动芯片需求
zh.summary: 三星电子报告了第三季度初步业绩,营业利润创纪录,超过100万亿韩元,由对AI芯片的前所未有的需求推动。该公司的强劲表现反映了半导体行业在驱动AI基础设施中的关键作用。

title: Inside India newsletter: Food crisis, economic shock ahead as India braces for El Niño
summary: India faces potential economic challenges as the super El Niño weather phenomenon threatens agricultural output and food security. The weather pattern poses risks to farm productivity and broader economic stability for the nation.
content: The super El Niño weather phenomenon is emerging as the latest headwind for the Indian economy.

zh.title: 印度内幕通讯:食品危机、经济冲击即将到来,印度为厄尔尼诺现象做准备
zh.summary: 印度面临潜在的经济挑战,因为超强厄尔尼诺天气现象威胁农业产出和粮食安全。这种天气模式对农场生产力和国家更广泛的经济稳定性构成风险。
